note: Hand-picked hero cards, chosen in the hero picker (node scripts/build_hero_picker.mjs, then open tools/hero-picker/index.html from a checkout). Entries may be a SKU (CHK-JW07-16) or a card id (checklistHero-jw07-16). Order is the order they appear. An empty list means the wall picks for itself: measured colourfulness, one palette per card, a product in every one. "never" names cards that stay in the library and are kept off the wall whatever the mix asks for: a SKU, a card id, or an offer card's template id (app.js, scOffWall).
